subject: 辽金北方匿名八角密檐砖佛塔（原创扩展）
prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: tianshu building-map sprite bld_kit_liao_jin_north_pagoda. Generate ONE anonymous Liao-Jin northern Buddhist brick pagoda, original game interpretation, using the reference ONLY for realistic historical material detail density, soft lighting, and isolated sprite finish. Do NOT copy the reference's storeyed timber tower: subject must be an OCTAGONAL solid grey-brick dense-eaves pagoda inspired by Liao masonry construction, a tall richly patterned lower body, closely stacked thirteen shallow projecting masonry eaves above with continuously diminishing widths, modest lotus-profile brick base, weathered pale warm-grey brick reliefs and blind recessed door/window motifs, compact old metal finial. No outside timber balconies, no large habitable storey windows, no Tibetan white stupa. Footprint ground plate is SQUARE 7 by 7 planning units. Orthographic yaw45 pitch30 EXACT 2:1 projection: ground diamond left/right vertices level, front corner centered horizontally and one quarter diamond width below the left/right line; ground edges slopes ±0.500. Vertical tower axis, no perspective. Base four corners visible on very THIN square stone skirt, not a chunky plinth. Entrance-like blind niche on screen lower-left-facing side. Entire tall finial and base fully visible with at least 10% alpha margin. True RGBA transparent background with no painted checkerboard or background. Key light SCREEN UPPER LEFT and tiny short soft contact shadow LOWER RIGHT. Same muted realism as Song kit. No text or pseudo-writing, people, animals, trees, surroundings, large shadow, flags, modern objects. One standalone static orientation.
SECOND CANDIDATE PRIORITY: base needs a clean SQUARE 2:1 diamond foundation, with straight front edges at ±0.5 slopes. At image width1024, left/right floor corners should be around x160/x864 at the SAME y1250, and bottom front corner x512,y1426 (2:1 projection). Use this geometry, but do not draw annotations. Do not round off the right corner. Tower remains dense-eaves brick form and full finial visible; the exact count is secondary to this anonymous historical silhouette. Thin base only.
negative: 文字、伪字、人物、现代物、背景、棋盘格、厚浮岛、透视、裁切、长阴影、清式彩画

notes: 八角砖塔及密集收分檐层明确，无宋式木楼阁外廊；匿名艺术概化，不声明精确十三层或天宁寺实址，不提前安放1119年具名原塔。可见底面两轴轻微偏浅；静态单视图。 已对原图执行view_image(original)。 第二候选正方形地台四角更清楚，宽深比接近1；斜率仍略偏浅。 单45°视图，allowRotation=false。 已对规格化成品执行view_image(original)：主体完整、无字无人、透明边缘留白；形制/投影残差以geometry_qa为准，未宣称严阈全部通过。
